item.title: Provisioning Everpure Cloud Azure Native Resources with the Azure CLI
item.description: I already walked through this with Terraform , provisioning an Everpure Cloud Azure Native storage pool, volume group, and volume, then mounting it to an Azure VM over iSCSI. Not everyone wants a Terraform state file for a one-off pool, so here is the same example with nothing but the Azure CLI.
